books.book_id: Unique identifier for the book record.
books.goodreads_book_id: Original Goodreads identifier for the book.
books.books_count: Number of editions/versions for the work.
books.authors: Author(s) as provided by the source dataset.
books.original_publication_year: First known publication year of the work.
books.original_title: Original title of the work when first published.
books.title: Title used for this edition/record.
books.ratings_count: Total count of ratings received across editions.
books.work_ratings_count: Total ratings count for the work across editions.
books.work_text_reviews_count: Count of text reviews for the work.

ratings.book_id: Unique identifier for the book record.
ratings.rating: Explicit rating value given by a user.
